name: Voxel Space
definition: A 2.5D technology that uses a color map and a depth map to generate a 3D looking environment by plotting vertical lines with a color obtained from the color map and an initial y-coordinate calculated from the depth map.
summary: Voxel Space is a 2.5D rendering technique that generates pseudo-3D environments by plotting vertical lines sampled from color and depth maps, avoiding polygon projection to suit hardware with limited floating-point capabilities.
